Manifest.Name: Zam's Collectibles
Manifest.Author: Zam
Manifest.Description: Zamco Electronics brings the Aug Warriors trading card game to the station: ten card sets across three power tiers, booster packs and boxes to open, cards to grade and sell, sets to seal, a card shop after hours, and a full card game to play. Cards are mod items: they are lost if the mod is disabled.
